purpose: Minimal immutable D3R1 evidence projections for offline execution-completion calibration; not production-authorized receipts or a new run.

extraction.receipt_fields: Exact original top-level fields, excluding module_outcomes/report_delta/testcase_execution_rows/testcase_outcomes; those collections are separately counted and sampled.
extraction.row_and_node_samples: First original element for each present outcome, in error/failed/skipped/passed order; zero-based source_index. Samples never replace the original complete collection.
extraction.report_delta_samples: Original entries matching sampled report paths, or first original new report when no identity rows exist.
extraction.assessments: All original assessment files whose receipt_id equals the selected final test receipt_id; no synthetic prerequisites or authorization flags added.
extraction.output: Selected exact lines from the identified JSONL record output; line numbers are one-based after str.splitlines(). Four complete record outputs hash to the original receipt output_content_hash; SeaTunnel has a disclosed truncated-output exception and separately verified XML.
extraction.reports: Parse only the selected original tar member. Verify member SHA-256 against original receipt report_delta. Retain suite attributes and testcase outcome elements; omit system-out, properties, and other unrelated content.
extraction.privacy: No environment dumps, credentials, tokens, host authority registry or whole large logs copied. Public project/source names, original receipt/run identifiers and /workspace paths are retained for provenance.
